### 👨‍💻 About me

Backend engineer from Brasília, Brazil, with <!--yoe-->5<!--/yoe-->+ years designing, building, and scaling distributed systems, RESTful APIs, and B2B SaaS platforms. I've shipped production backends in Ruby on Rails, C#/.NET, and Python, and I'm equally productive in all three: Rails for product features and RESTful APIs, C# and .NET (on top of a solid Java foundation) for microservices and asynchronous architectures with Kafka, RabbitMQ, and Redis, and Python for APIs, data pipelines, and AI integrations. I'm comfortable going deep into system design, production incidents, and end-to-end observability with Datadog and Dynatrace.

- 🔭 Software Engineer at Ploomes, building backend microservices for an enterprise B2B CRM
- 🧪 Built a dedicated sandbox environment so enterprise clients can safely validate CRM configurations before going to production
- 📥 Designed bulk data ingestion pipelines, sales reporting, goal tracking, and integrations with Microsoft services and Facebook Leads
- 🧠 Built secure APIs and Python + Airflow data workflows for an AI-driven legal recruitment platform, including prompt-engineered AI features
- 🚨 Comfortable in the hot seat: production incidents, performance bottlenecks, distributed service failures, and security incident response
- 🤖 I use AI-assisted development (Claude Code) to ship faster and automate test coverage, without skipping the code review
- 🧑‍🏫 Mentored junior engineers and led pair programming and code review sessions
- 🎓 B.Sc. in Software Engineering (Unicesumar)
- 💼 Open to remote Backend / Software Engineer roles
- 🗣️ Portuguese (native), English (fluent), Spanish (intermediate)
